violations.why: writer1_isr (prio 3) can preempt closer2_isr's JudgeCondi between its two reads of test_global_var1.
writer2_isr (prio 4) can preempt JudgeCondi between its two reads of test_global_var2.
The increment in closer3_isr is a non-atomic read-modify-write. writer3_isr (prio 5) can preempt it and its write is lost.
closer2_isr sets 42 at line 764. A same-priority closer ISR can preempt it, and its i8xx_tco_write resets the variable to 0 at line 421. The check at line 765 then reads the changed value.
closer3_isr sets 42, and another closer ISR can preempt it and reset the variable to 0 before the check at line 778.
i8xx_tco_release in closer3_isr reads the variable, then another closer ISR can preempt and write 42. The release then overwrites it with 0.
